name: Nikolai, Charnel Brother

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Burned by Sunlight
traits.details: Whenever Nikolai starts his turn in direct sunlight, he takes 10 radiant damage.

effect.description: The target is marked until the end of Nikolai’s next turn.

hit.description: damage, and the target is marked (save ends).

miss.description: Half damage, and the target is marked until the end of Nikolai’s next turn.

effect.description: Nikolai becomes a swarm of bats and flies up to his speed. During this movement he is insubstantial. At the end of the movement, each enemy adjacent to him is marked until the end of Nikolai’s next turn.

powers.name: Vampiric Mark
powers.trigger: An enemy within 5 squares of Nikolai and marked by him makes an attack that doesn’t include him as a target.

effect.description: Close burst 5 (triggering enemy in the burst). The target takes 15 necrotic damage.
